relations.quote: I must write no more; I must keep it to say to Jonathan, my husband.
she told me all over again about Arthur and their coming marriage.
THREE proposals in one day! ... number One came just before lunch. I told you of him, Dr. John Seward, the lunatic-asylum man
Mr. Morris sat down beside me ... I couldn't help feeling a sort of exultation that he was number two in one day.
Mrs. Westenra has got an idea that sleep-walkers always go out on roofs of houses ... she is naturally anxious about Lucy, and she tells me that her husband, Lucy's father, had the same habit
Dr. Seward, may I ask a favour? I want to see your patient, Mr. Renfield.
told her that my old master, Van Helsing, the great specialist, was coming to stay with me
Jonathan and Mr. Hawkins are busy all day; for, now that Jonathan is a partner, Mr. Hawkins wants to tell him all about the clients.
It is Mina Murray that I came to see that was friend of that poor dear child Lucy Westenra.
while Count Dracula was speaking, there was that in his eyes and in his bearing which made me remember that I was a prisoner
what had occurred with poor Lucy when the Count had sucked her blood.

that night at Carfax when we first enter the Count's house.
